```sql
SELECT d.fiscal_year, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2026
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year
```

```sql
SELECT o.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND o.order_date_local >= DATE '2026-03-01' 
  AND o.order_date_local < DATE '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY o.region
```

```sql
SELECT o.channel, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND d.calendar_year = 2025
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY o.channel
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_first_order
FROM analytics.dim_customers AS c
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = c.first_order_on
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 2026
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.fct_order_lines AS l USING (order_id)
WHERE o.order_date_local >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY o.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
```

```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(fol.net_amount_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_order_lines fol
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_orders fo ON fol.order_id = fo.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_products dp ON fol.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date dd ON fo.order_date_local = dd.date_day
WHERE 
    dp.category = 'tents' 
    AND dd.calendar_year = 2025
    AND fo.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date_local >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date_local < DATE '2026-01-01'
```

```sql
SELECT o.region, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur) / count(*), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' 
  AND o.order_date_local >= DATE '2026-03-01' 
  AND o.order_date_local < DATE '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY o.region
```

```sql
SELECT d.fiscal_quarter, round(sum(o.net_revenue_eur), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders AS o
JOIN analytics.dim_date AS d ON d.date_day = o.order_date_local
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND d.fiscal_year = 2026 AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
GROUP BY d.fiscal_quarter
ORDER BY d.fiscal_quarter
```
